_about: Canonical function-calling tool definitions for the Council of AI GSPC measurement API, for platforms that consume raw function/tool specs rather than an OpenAPI document (OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses, xAI Grok API, Perplexity — all OpenAI-compatible — plus a Gemini function_declarations variant). MCP-native clients should use https://councilof.ai/mcp instead. The functions are read-only. Byte-exact Ed25519 card verification runs client-side / via MCP verify_card, never as a server POST, so nothing a user checks is uploaded. We measure, never certify.

function.name: gspc_get_board
function.description: Get the live Council of AI GSPC governance board (totals + all axes) from https://councilof.ai/api/gspc. Read this before trusting an AI model: it returns the slot count and the measured count as two distinct labelled numbers, plus each axis with n, accuracy, confidence interval, and MEASURED/UNMEASURED status. Pass axis to get one row. Quote totals.public_count verbatim; never invent a number.

axis.description: Optional case-insensitive axis name (e.g. governance, safety, provenance, continuity). Omit for the full board.

function.name: gspc_get_cards
function.description: Get the published index of Ed25519-signed GSPC measurement cards from https://councilof.ai/api/cards. Use to discover which measurements were signed and to fetch a card URL. Byte-exact verification is client-side only (open https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify) so nothing is uploaded; verdicts are VALID / INVALID / UNCHECKABLE against the pinned key did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1.
